stem:
The graph of a quadratic function is shown on the grid.

Which statement appears to be true?

options.label: B
options.text: The maximum value of the function is 3.

options.label: C
options.text: The vertex of the graph of the function is \(4, 1\).

options.label: D
options.text: The equation of the axis of symmetry of the graph of the function is \(x = 1\).

visual_elements: graph of quadratic function showing a parabola opening downward with vertex at (1,4), zeros approximately at x = -1 and x = 3
